prompt: Add an Active situation to wiki/entities/place/Mercatura.md: the only way to resolve the city's pressure is one correct lever in the sealed vault under the bombs memorial. No investigation clues, no alternate solutions, no costly bypass — miss the lever and the session stops.
expected_output: Refuse clue-less single-lever trap. Require discoverable signs, ≥2 approaches or a costly bypass, and do not invent a sealed-vault crisis as canon on Mercatura (pressure currently none established; S1 bombs closed).

assertions.text: Does not create a single-correct-lever Active situation with no investigation clues and no alternate/costly-bypass paths
If proposing a situation, includes visible signs the party can encounter before deep investigation and ≥2 viable approaches or a costly bypass
Does not invent a sealed vault under the bombs memorial as established Mercatura canon — bombs/Otar/Solange stay closed Season 1 history
Does not invent live city pressure where the wiki states none established, unless clearly marked proposed/invention
Any speculative situation cites grounding pages in process-notes.md, agent_report.md, or transcript.md rather than writing silent canon
